about_the_game:
Forget epic quests and dragon-slaying — this is war for the vibes.
In Sesh-On, a turn-based tactics game of booze, drugs, and chaos, you’ll battle across grid-based party zones to keep the sesh alive. Stack the dancefloor with fun, fling crème pies in nerds’ faces, and watch your carefully balanced vibe meter explode into glorious mayhem.

But beware: the nerds are everywhere. If they kill the vibe, the party’s over.

🎮 Key Features

  • Turn-Based Tactics, Party Style
    Every move matters — deploy drinks, drugs, and dumb fun with surgical precision to maximise the vibes.

  • The Vibe Is Everything
    Your ultimate resource. Boost it with chaos, burn it with mistakes, and protect it at all costs.

  • Ban the Nerds
    Outthink, outdrink, and outright humiliate vibe-killing nerds with slapstick attacks and bad ideas that somehow work.

  • Endless Party Stories
    Every run is different, with randomised setups, escalating chaos, and new ways to either rule the sesh… or crash it.

  • Funny, Crude, and Very Much Not Medieval
    This isn’t a kingdom. It’s your mate’s living room at 4am, and only the strongest party survives.

🎯 Why Play Sesh-On?

If you love the tactical depth of games like Into the Breach but wish they came with more cheap lager, pies to the face, and bad decisions at sunrise — Sesh-On is your new favourite disaster.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains:
Frequent references to and depictions of drug and alcohol use.
Crude humour and adult themes.
Sexual references and suggestive content (cartoonish, comedic tone).
Mild cartoon violence (e.g. food fights, slapstick attacks).
The game does not contain depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual sex, or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 VRAM); Radeon R9 380 (2048 VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Forget knights and dragons — Sesh-On is a grid-based strategy roguelite where the only quest is to raise the vibe. Deploy drinks, drugs, and party tricks to keep the sesh pumpin. But beware: the nerds are coming, and they’ll kill the buzz if you don’t deal with them fast.
